scope: Recorded double-precision single-channel pilot; no browser simulation.

calibration.method: Independent depth=0.05 clean modulation; unwrapped phase over 0.5,1,...,10 Hz. Fixed before noisy trials. Onset uses a carrier switched on at 3 s.

known_pure_delay_alignment.scope: Smooth AM-power oracle through 20 Hz. Does not prove interpolation accuracy for arbitrary transients or out-of-band residuals.

adc_aliasing.scope: Analog-only tone at ADC_fs-110; no desired signal or noise. Very small residuals may lie below the ADC quantization step.

digital_decimator_aliasing.scope: Stage-isolated exact floating-point tones; analog and ADC deliberately bypassed. Same bandpass, smoothing, and decimation in both paths.

component_isolation.scope: One seed, 2 Hz modulation, 2 kHz multirate; diagnostic attribution only, not population statistics. Error terms are not additive after squaring.

nominal_noisy_alignment.scope: One seed, 2 Hz, full-rate 2 kHz, fixed fractional queries; not a bound for other spectra.
